content.short: TRIBE marketplace helps creators monetize multimedia content through a blockchain-based market.
content.description: TRIBE marketplace presents itself as a Web3 producer and content monetization platform for digital creators. Its site describes a multimedia blockchain market, creator content, moderation, chats, and marketplace-style item activity. It belongs in the NFT and creator-economy side of the TON list because the product is about content ownership and monetization. WEB3 producer for content creators (content monetization platform). TRIBE marketplace supports NFT activity around discovery, lending, analysis, valuation, or asset management instead of acting only as a marketplace.
